name: Forced-cover climax: deep-negative funding + realized-vol spike (NOT vol-spike-alone)
rationale: Thesis: a realized-vol climax marks forced flow, but vol-spikes alone are ambiguous (could be a long blow-off). The squeeze setup is the vol climax that is SHORT-driven: funding deeply negative means the forced sellers are over-extended shorts whose covering reverses the move UP. Entry (long-only spot): funding_rate < deeply-negative floor [-0.005,-0.0005] (crowded shorts) AND vol_realized > a fitted spike floor (the forced-flow climax). vol_realized is BOUNDED so gt on level is valid. DISCONFIRMER: must beat vol_realized>floor ALONE with the SAME floor and no funding gate — if lone vol-spike reversion matches net Sharpe, the funding gate is decorative. The positioning gate is the claim: it must isolate the short-driven subset of climaxes. funding_feature null — level, not carry. Exit on funding normalizing up or a profit target.
catalyst: realized-vol climax driven by crowded-short capitulation (deep-negative funding)
